The full app now lives together at **http://maker:4001** — saving, opening, finding, and read status in one calm place. Please try this final flow end to end:

1. **Focus on what's left:** click the **To read** tab. Notice the count and that finished items drop away.
2. **Finish something:** on any card, click **Mark as read**. It leaves the "To read" view (but isn't gone) — switch to **Finished** and you'll see it there, at full prominence (not faded).
3. **See the calm dimming:** switch to **All** — finished items are gently dimmed so your eye rests on what's pending.
4. **Combine focus with finding:** type `reading` in search, then click between **All / To read / Finished** — the counts and results reflect both your search *and* the chosen view.

Does this give you the "still to read vs. finished, without losing anything" experience you were after?

---

Once you're happy here, we'll have the whole picture in place. I'd then like to walk you briefly through a few **boundary situations** — things like your very first use with nothing saved yet, a page whose details can't be read automatically, and a very long title — to make sure the app stays calm in those moments too, before I propose moving into building the real thing.
